Alex Turner: Quick heads-up — PR #8214 needs a sanity check before the 30m cutoff at 21:00 PT. It's a small KV cache TTL fix that caused a mem-growth in prod canary. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8214
Maria Chen: I'm coming in 10m, can run smoke and lgtm if green.
Chris Patel: Pinged infra owners, will check infra-side config changes. reading now.
Alex Turner: Tests to run: `./scripts/smoke_test.sh --pr 8214` and `pytest tests/e2e/test_kv_cache.py::test_ttl_regression -k quick` — smoke should finish ~5m.
deploy-bot: Deploy window opens 21:10 PT, automatic rollback at 21:40 PT if no success. (scheduled by @releasebot)
Maria Chen: smoke passed locally on my laptop, no regressions: `OK 12 passed` :thumbsup:
Chris Patel: looked through diff, tiny nit but not blocking. leaving inline comment.
Jordan (oncall): FYI, if canary shows >5% mem increase we abort. I'll monitor.
Alex Turner: Thanks — need one more approval to hit cut. @Chris can you approve after nit? @Maria can approve once comments addressed? :pray:
Chris Patel: pushing commit to address comment now.
Maria Chen: approved.
Chris Patel: approved.
Alex Turner: merging now, will trigger canary. Thanks all :rocket:
deploy-bot: PR #8214 merged by Alex Turner — canary deployment started.
Jordan (oncall): monitoring canary, CPU/mem dashboards up.
Jordan (oncall): canary looks stable after 15m, no mem spikes. :thumbsup: to continue.
Alex Turner: rolling to prod. closing thread.
